Verta offers three account tiers: Tier 1, Tier 2 and Tier 3. The tier
determines the FX spread, the free monthly conversion allowance and the
transfer limits.

Glossary

The midpoint between the buy and sell price of a currency pair on the wholesale
market. Verta quotes conversions relative to this rate.

Verta tariff schedule
## Transfer fees by type
| Transfer type | Flat fee | Percentage fee |
|---|---|---|
| Internal | EUR 0.00 | 0% |
| SEPA | EUR 0.35 | 0% |

Fee details
## How the SWIFT fee is composed
A SWIFT transfer carries a flat fee plus a percentage of the EUR equivalent of
the amount sent. Correspondent bank charges deducted en route are outside the
control of Verta and are not refunded.

Fee details
## Card payment fee
Card payments carry a percentage fee on the EUR equivalent. No flat fee
applies.

Transfers
## Failed transfers
A transfer rejected by the beneficiary bank is returned within five business
days. Fees already charged on a returned SWIFT transfer are not refunded.

answers:
A SWIFT transfer at Verta carries:

- **Flat fee:** EUR 15.00
- **Percentage fee:** 0.3% of the EUR equivalent of the transfer amount

For example, if you send EUR 10,000, the fee would be EUR 15.00 + (0.3% × EUR 10,000) = EUR 15.00 + EUR 30.00 = EUR 45.00 total.

Please note that correspondent bank charges deducted along the way are outside Verta's control and are not refunded.
